verdict.rationale: Brave publishes an official MCP server at github.com/brave/brave-search-mcp-server. It exposes web, local, place, image, video and news search, LLM context, and summarization tools. First-party guides walk through connecting it to the Claude desktop app and to Claude Cowork on Amazon Bedrock, and a probe confirms the official repo. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually running the MCP server (the community items cover API-key and ToS use with OpenClaw, not the MCP server).
